requirements.text: Patients must be able to book, cancel, or reschedule appointments online.
Patients must be able to request repeat prescriptions online without needing to call in.
Patients must have secure online access to their test results after clinician review.
The portal must enhance patient experience and reduce pressure on reception staff.
The appointment booking process must be user-friendly and intuitive.
Patients must be able to see available time slots for appointments.
Patients must be able to select the type of appointment they need.
Patients must be able to flag urgent needs during the booking process.
Automated reminders must be sent to patients via their preferred method.
The repeat prescription request process must allow patients to log in and see their current medications.
Patients must be able to add notes to their prescription requests.
The system must automatically check for potential medication issues.
Patients must receive confirmation of their prescription requests.
The system must integrate with existing practice management software for prescription approvals.
The test results system must have robust identity verification for patient access.
Test results must be presented in a clear and easy-to-understand format.
Only authorized results should be accessible to patients.
Patients must have the option to ask questions regarding their test results.
Patients must receive notifications when new test results are available.
All patient data must be encrypted during transmission and storage.
The system must implement strict access controls with an audit trail.
The portal must comply with GDPR and relevant Irish data protection legislation.
Regular security assessments and updates must be conducted.
Clear protocols for data breach response must be established.
The portal must include accessibility features for patients with low digital literacy or elderly patients.
The integration with existing practice management software must be seamless without full data migration.
Ongoing support and training for staff must be available after initial onboarding.
